title: VF-023 rerun: the conformance corpus under auto --confirm, now that a JBMC refutation through a stub that doesn't reproduce is no verdict (closes VF-023 when it passes)
description: application-core merge loop (llm-dlc/loops/application-core.md, Phase 5 step 1, interface request 3), at the commit that submits this job; acceptance row V2 (the list model under --confirm). VF-023: job 20261108-070211's step 2 failed with 8 disagreements, all listSizes and listChange under --gaps strict and assume: the own checker proves them, JBMC 6.11.0 refutes them through its stub of java.util.List.size()/isEmpty() (located by jobs 20261108-091002 and 093809), and the interpreter replays the witness as holding. The change: equivalence::confirm now treats a JBMC refutation whose witness doesn't reproduce in the interpreter and whose preflight finds a stub (a gap record) as Confirmed::NoVerdict naming the stubs, as it already did for a JBMC defect; the own checker's proof stands, not confirmed. A witness that reproduces is still a disagreement. Reproducer: lib/tests/values.rs confirm_takes_a_refutation_through_a_jbmc_stub_that_does_not_reproduce_for_no_verdict, un-ignored, passes inline and fails with the rule removed. This job reruns the old job's step 2 unchanged. Domain and bounds: the corpus's (int parameters, the claims' assumptions, unwind 16). Engine: native via auto, JBMC confirming. Expected verdict: listSizes and listChange Verified with confirmation NoVerdict (not Disagreed); no other case changes. Expected process status: exit 0. matchesExpected is the test passing. This is VF-023's second attempt and its last under the timebox.
